instruction: Review gui_005_heat_sink_base.step in SolidWorks, a flat heat-sink base spanning X=-45 to X=45, Y=-25 to Y=25, and Z=0 to Z=6 (90 x 50 x 6 mm). Open SOLIDWORKS 2025 from its desktop shortcut, then load `gui_005_heat_sink_base.step`. Add nine parallel fins on the top face at Z=6. Each fin runs along Y for the full 50 mm length, is 2 mm thick in X, and extends 18 mm upward from Z=6 to Z=24. The nine fin centers are equally spaced along X with the outermost centers at X=+/-32 mm. Merge fins and base into one connected body. Add 0.5 mm fillets to the fin top edges. Export C:\Users\User\Desktop\gui_005_heat_sink_out.step with total height 24 mm.
